JournalEntry.title: JournalEntry
JournalEntry.description: A user-authored journal entry or reflection conversation

messages.description: List of multi-turn conversational messages between user and Gemini

excludedFromAI.description: Whether this journal entry is excluded from AI memory extraction and retrieval

ThoughtThread.title: ThoughtThread
ThoughtThread.description: An evolving thought thread connecting semantically related journal entries

id.description: Unique identifier of the thought thread

title.description: Short AI-generated title of the thread

description.description: Short description of what the thread is about

entryIds.description: List of related journal entry IDs

updatedAt.description: Date the thread was most recently updated (ISO timestamp)

UnfinishedThought.title: UnfinishedThought
UnfinishedThought.description: An idea, decision, question, or goal left unresolved in past reflections

id.description: Unique identifier of the unfinished thought

title.description: Short title of the unfinished thought

originalContext.description: Quote or context snippet from original reflection

dateFirstMentioned.description: ISO date string when first recorded

entryId.description: ID of the source journal entry

threadId.description: ID of associated thought thread, if any

whyUnfinished.description: Objective explanation of why considered unresolved

resolvedAt.description: ISO date string when marked resolved

remindAt.description: ISO date string when to remind user

PerspectiveReplay.title: PerspectiveReplay
PerspectiveReplay.description: A structured comparison between past and current perspectives on an older journal entry

originalEntryId.description: ID of the original journal entry being replayed

originalEntryDate.description: ISO date string when original entry was recorded

reflectionQuestion.description: The reflection starter question presented to the user

originalPerspective.description: Summary of what the user thought then

currentPerspective.description: Summary of what the user thinks now

whatChanged.description: Structured breakdown of differences in stance or thinking

whatStayedConsistent.description: Structured breakdown of consistent values or principles

possibleReasons.description: Reasons for the shift supported strictly by user journal history

replayDate.description: ISO timestamp when the replay was performed

ActionExperiment.title: ActionExperiment
ActionExperiment.description: A concrete, small, optional experiment derived from recurring patterns in Thought Threads

id.description: Unique identifier of the action experiment

entryIds.description: List of journal entry IDs providing evidence

insight.description: The recurring pattern or concern identified across entries

experiment.description: The specific, small, realistic experiment to test

timeframe.description: Suggested duration or timeframe for the experiment

evidenceQuotes.description: Direct quotes or references from journal entries providing evidence

whyThisExperiment.description: Explanation connecting the experiment to the journal content without life-improving guarantees

notes.description: Optional user notes or reflections on the experiment

changedExperimentText.description: Updated experiment description if modified by the user

completedAt.description: ISO timestamp when the user completed the experiment

AIMemory.title: AIMemory
AIMemory.description: User-controlled distilled factual memory used for long-term AI context

id.description: Unique identifier of the memory item

fact.description: The distilled fact, preference, or goal remembered by the AI

sourceId.description: ID of the source journal entry or interaction

sourceTitle.description: Title of the source journal entry or interaction

status.description: Status of memory item in AI retrieval

hasEmbedding.description: Whether a vector embedding is associated with this memory

AIMemoryEmbedding.title: AIMemoryEmbedding
AIMemoryEmbedding.description: Isolated vector embedding record corresponding to an AI memory item

id.description: Memory ID this embedding belongs to

UserMemorySettings.title: UserMemorySettings
UserMemorySettings.description: User preferences for AI long-term memory creation and retrieval

memoryCreationEnabled.description: Master switch to enable or disable future AI memory creation

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp of last settings modification

/users/{userId}/entries/{entryId}.description: User-isolated journal entries and reflection conversation logs

/users/{userId}/threads/{threadId}.description: User-isolated evolving thought threads connecting related journal entries

/users/{userId}/unfinished_thoughts/{tho.description: User-isolated unfinished thoughts surfaced from past reflections

/users/{userId}/replays/{replayId}.description: User-isolated perspective replays comparing past vs current viewpoints

/users/{userId}/actions/{actionId}.description: User-isolated small concrete experiments derived from recurring thought threads

/users/{userId}/memories/{memoryId}.description: User-isolated remembered items used for contextual AI reflection

/users/{userId}/ai_memories/{memoryId}.description: User-isolated remembered items used for contextual AI reflection

/users/{userId}/memory_embeddings/{embed.description: User-isolated vector embedding representations of memories

/users/{userId}/settings/{settingId}.description: User-isolated preferences controlling AI memory creation and retrieval

/users/{userId}/memory_settings/{setting.description: User-isolated preferences controlling AI memory creation and retrieval
